leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a component that demonstrates stale closure issues in concurrent mode
Apply the useRef hook to persist values across re-renders and avoid race conditions
Construct a custom hook that safely manages state updates during concurrent renders
Configure useEffect dependencies to prevent infinite loops in concurrent scenarios
Update component state using functional updates to ensure consistency with previous state
Bind event handlers with stable references to prevent memory leaks during rapid re-renders
Control the timing of side effects with cleanup functions in concurrent mode
